}# Name: Continuous integration
# Purpose: Validates repository content, runs the offline test suite, builds the examples, verifies OpenCode agent discovery, and dry-runs every benchmark task.
# Usage: Runs on push to main, on pull requests, and on manual dispatch.
# Validation: ./scripts/validation/validate.sh and python3 -m unittest discover -s tests -t .
# References: docs/architecture/testing.md, docs/troubleshooting/ci.md
name: ci

on:
  push:
    branches: [main]
  pull_request:
  workflow_dispatch:

permissions:
  contents: read

concurrency:
  group: ci-${{ github.ref }}
  cancel-in-progress: true

jobs:
  static:
    timeout-minutes: 15
    name: static (${{ matrix.os }})
    strategy:
      fail-fast: false
      matrix:
        os: [ubuntu-latest, macos-latest]
    runs-on: ${{ matrix.os }}
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v7
      - uses: actions/setup-python@v7
        with:
          python-version: "3.12"
      - name: Install validation dependencies
        run: python -m pip install --quiet pyyaml
      - name: Validate repository
        run: ./scripts/validation/validate.sh
      - name: Verify catalog files are tracked
        run: git ls-files --error-unmatch catalog/registry.json catalog/index.md
      - name: Lint GitHub workflows
        if: runner.os == 'Linux'
        run: go run github.com/rhysd/actionlint/cmd/actionlint@v1.7.12 .github/workflows/*.yml
      - name: Local release check
        if: runner.os == 'Linux'
        run: ./scripts/release/local_release_check.sh
      - name: Check release version consistency
        run: python scripts/release/check_version.py
      - name: Check catalog drift
        run: python scripts/catalog/build_catalog.py --check
      - name: Check shell syntax
        run: |
          for file in scripts/installation/*.sh scripts/maintenance/*.sh scripts/validation/*.sh scripts/benchmarking/*.sh benchmarks/harness/*.sh skills/*/*.sh; do
            bash -n "$file"
          done
      - name: ShellCheck
        if: runner.os == 'Linux'
        run: |
          sudo apt-get update
          sudo apt-get install --yes shellcheck
          shellcheck scripts/*/*.sh benchmarks/harness/*.sh skills/*/*.sh

  test:
    timeout-minutes: 15
    name: test (${{ matrix.os }})
    strategy:
      fail-fast: false
      matrix:
        os: [ubuntu-latest, macos-latest]
    runs-on: ${{ matrix.os }}
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v7
      - uses: actions/setup-python@v7
        with:
          python-version: "3.12"
      - name: Install test dependencies
        run: python -m pip install --quiet pyyaml
      - name: Run unit and integration tests
        run: python -m unittest discover -s tests -t . -v

  cli:
    timeout-minutes: 15
    name: cli
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v7
      - uses: actions/setup-python@v7
        with:
          python-version: "3.12"
      - uses: actions/setup-node@v7
        with:
          node-version: "20"
      - name: Install OpenCode V2
        run: npm install --global @opencode/cli@2.2.7
      - name: Build the wheel
        run: python -m pip wheel ./packages/toolwright_cli --no-deps --wheel-dir dist
      - name: Install the CLI
        run: python -m pip install ./packages/toolwright_cli pyyaml
      - name: Diagnose the repository
        run: toolwright doctor --json --no-mcp
      - name: Verify profiles and catalog
        run: |
          toolwright profile verify
          toolwright catalog verify --check-drift
      - name: Check task board and plugin
        run: |
          toolwright task list > /dev/null
          toolwright task status > /dev/null
          node --check configs/opencode/plugins/toolwright-memory.js
          toolwright install --only plugin --target "$RUNNER_TEMP/plugin-project" --dry-run > /dev/null
      - name: Check stats, eval, and pilots
        run: |
          toolwright stats --results benchmarks/results --format json > /dev/null
          toolwright eval > /dev/null
          toolwright pilot list > /dev/null
          toolwright pilot run hono --dry-run > /dev/null
      - name: Check memory and spec commands
        run: |
          toolwright memory search decision > /dev/null
          toolwright memory preamble --budget 500 > /dev/null
          toolwright spec list > /dev/null
      - name: Run verification gates
        run: |
          toolwright verify --only validate --only lint
          toolwright govern contracts
      - name: Exercise the install lifecycle
        run: |
          target="$RUNNER_TEMP/toolwright-project"
          toolwright install --profile minimal --target "$target" --dry-run
          toolwright install --profile minimal --target "$target" --apply
          toolwright install --profile minimal --target "$target" --apply | tee reapply.log
          grep -q "already up to date" reapply.log
          toolwright update --check --target "$target"
          toolwright uninstall --target "$target" --apply --yes

  docs:
    timeout-minutes: 10
    name: docs
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v7
      - uses: actions/setup-python@v7
        with:
          python-version: "3.12"
      - name: Install MkDocs
        run: python -m pip install --quiet mkdocs-material==9.8.1
      - name: Build documentation site
        run: mkdocs build --strict

  examples:
    timeout-minutes: 20
    name: examples
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v7
      - uses: actions/setup-node@v7
        with:
          node-version: "20"
      - name: TypeScript example
        working-directory: examples/typescript
        run: |
          npm install
          npm test
      - uses: actions/setup-dotnet@v6
        with:
          dotnet-version: "8.0.x"
      - name: C# example
        working-directory: examples/csharp
        run: dotnet test Example.Tests/Example.Tests.csproj

  opencode-profile:
    timeout-minutes: 15
    name: opencode profile
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v7
      - uses: actions/setup-node@v7
        with:
          node-version: "20"
      - uses: actions/setup-python@v7
        with:
          python-version: "3.12"
      - name: Install OpenCode V2
        run: npm install --global @opencode/cli@2.2.7
      - name: Install profile into a temporary project
        run: |
          target="$RUNNER_TEMP/profile-project"
          mkdir -p "$target"
          ./scripts/installation/install.sh --apply --only opencode,agents,commands,skills,ralph --target "$target"
      - name: Use the minimal profile for deterministic discovery
        run: cp configs/opencode/minimal.jsonc "$RUNNER_TEMP/profile-project/.opencode/opencode.jsonc"
      - name: Verify agent discovery
        env:
          OPENCODE_CONFIG: ${{ runner.temp }}/profile-project/.opencode/opencode.jsonc
        run: |
          cd "$RUNNER_TEMP/profile-project"
          opencode --standalone debug agents > agents.json
          python3 - <<'PY'
          import json
          from pathlib import Path

          agents = json.loads(Path("agents.json").read_text())
          ids = {agent["id"] for agent in agents}
          required = {
              "coordinator", "planner", "researcher", "architect",
              "backend-developer", "frontend-developer", "database-specialist",
              "code-reviewer", "test-engineer", "security-reviewer",
              "performance-analyst", "documentation-engineer",
          }
          missing = required - ids
          if missing:
              raise SystemExit(f"missing agents: {sorted(missing)}")
          print(f"agents discovered: {len(ids)}")
          PY

  harness:
    timeout-minutes: 10
    name: harness dry-run
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v7
      - uses: actions/setup-python@v7
        with:
          python-version: "3.12"
      - name: Dry-run every benchmark task
        run: |
          for task in benchmarks/tasks/*.json; do
            ./benchmarks/harness/run.sh --arm baseline --task "$task" --dry-run
          done

part.text:
Done. `dotnet test Example.Tests/Example.Tests.csproj` passes: **19 passed, 0 failed** (baseline was 4).

## What changed

**`Example/Program.cs`** — validation now returns field-keyed errors instead of anonymous strings, with message/field names as named constants (`UserFields`, `UserMessages`) so tests and the endpoint share one source of truth. Existing message wording is unchanged.

**`Example/CreateUserEndpoint.cs`** (new) — the endpoint, dependency-free (only `System.Text.Json` from the shared framework, no new NuGet packages):
- `CreateUserEndpoint.Handle(string? jsonBody)` parses the raw body and returns `EndpointResult` (success + request, or problem).
- Missing/blank body and the JSON `null` literal → `400` problem, type `…/problems/missing-body`.
- Unparseable JSON, wrong JSON shape (`[…]`), and wrong field types (`"age": "thirty"`) → `400` problem, type `…/problems/malformed-body`.
- Readable but invalid payload → `400` problem, type `…/problems/validation-failed` with an `errors` map keyed by field.
- `ProblemResponse` mirrors the RFC 9457 members (`type`, `title`, `status`, `detail`, `errors`). The project is a class library with no ASP.NET Core pipeline, so it defines the document locally rather than pulling in the `Microsoft.AspNetCore.App` framework reference; switching to `ProblemDetails` later is a type swap at one call site.

**`Example.Tests/CreateUserEndpointTests.cs`** (new) — valid payload (including case-insensitive and omitted optional `age`), a 4-case missing-payload theory, a 4-case malformed-payload theory, and a field-error problem case.

**`Example.Tests/ValidationTests.cs`** — updated to the field-keyed contract, plus new coverage for `@`-less email, blank name, and multiple simultaneous field errors.

Verification:
- `dotnet test Example.Tests/Example.Tests.csproj` → 19/19 pass.
- `dotnet build -warnaserror` → 0 warnings (nullable annotations clean, no suppressions).

Changes are left unstaged; nothing was added or committed. Suggested commit message:

```
feat(examples/csharp): validate create-user payloads and return problem responses

Add CreateUserEndpoint, which rejects missing, malformed, and invalid JSON
payloads with an RFC 9457-shaped ProblemResponse, and key Validator errors by
field. Cover valid, missing, and malformed payloads with xunit tests.
```

Two pre-existing issues I did not touch, both out of scope: `FileResolver.Resolve` is still deliberately path-traversal-vulnerable (per the README), and `Validator` has no maximum name length.
